messages:
Priya M.: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: release cadence and oncall questions. Can we capture the decisions here so teams can act?
Sam H.: TL;DR: prefer 3-week planning as default to reduce mid-sprint churn, but teams may stay at 2 or 4 weeks if necessary. Focus is on predictable windows rather than forced homogeneity.
Jules K.: If teams move to 3 weeks, do oncall rotations change?
Sam H.: Yes \u2014 primary oncall becomes 7-day rotations (Mon-Sun) to minimize handovers, secondaries unchanged (nights/holidays). Expect fewer shifts per quarter.
Aria L.: Any change to paging SLAs?
Sam H.: Paging policy stays: sev1 page immed; ack <=15m; mitigation plan <=30m. We're updating runbooks to include explicit 15/30 checklist actions.
Ken P.: SLA targets for Dedicated customers?
Sam H.: Default Dedicated gen profiles: p95 <= 250ms. Long-context / special models will have explicit profile SLAs (example: 64k context p95 <= 700ms). Exceptions will be documented by model.
Lina S.: How will we gate model rollouts on quality?
Sam H.: New requirement: prerelease eval harness (baseline prompts + metrics), no-regression gate on embeddings similarity and toxicity, plus canary stage with automated metric checks.
Priya M.: Paste the agreed canary template?
Sam H.: Example default template (for discussion): `{"canary_percent":5, "stages":[5,25,100], "health_metrics":["p95_latency","error_rate","quality_regressions"], "auto_promote_on":"all_checks_green"}`
Jules K.: CI auto-promote?
Sam H.: Yes \u2014 auto-promote after 2 consecutive green evals and 30m with no new errors. Ops can abort via deployment dashboard.
Aria L.: Who owns runbooks and post-release checks?
Jules K.: I'll own runbook updates. Aria will own post-release checklist and eval prompt sets.
Ken P.: I'll draft SLA blurb and update status pages.
Priya M.: Action items: Sam update rollout template in infra repo; Jules refresh runbook; Aria publish eval sets; Ken update customer SLA docs. Drop PR links in #eng-process. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment started for release/infra-2026-03 at 2134567920 :rocket:
Lina S.: Any change to postmortem timing?
Sam H.: No \u2014 keep 72h initial summary, 7-day RCA. We'll add quick health checks at 2h and 24h after major rollouts.
Priya M.: Thanks everyone \u2014 leadership will review progress in next sync. :white_check_mark:
